name: Cheer Moe ~Watashi Ouen Shiteru Kara~
original_name: チアもえ～わたし応艶してるからっ～
source:
The school looks normal at first sight. There is the cheer leading club and the members practice hard every day. Do they only cheer during games? Well, actually no. The cheer learders also leave stress of sport club members using their bodies....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108083616/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007101]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
这所学园乍看之下平平无奇，校内的啦啦队社员们每天都在挥汗如雨地刻苦训练。可她们当真只会在赛场上呐喊助威吗？实则不然——私底下，啦啦队员们还会用自己的肉体替运动部社员们排解积攒的压力……

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108083616/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007101]ErogeShop[/url]]
